body:
There's really no useful information here about your project but sounds like a duplicate of:
* https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/115484

@AThousandShips What information can i provide that helps? The errors show in the output log as soon as i load the project. No interaction with the engine from my side, no stack trace, no hint to what it could be related except from the error message itself. I am willing to help, but just have no clue what information to provide.

What the project contains, I understand that it can be hard to know what's going on but we can't figure that out without knowing what your project is like

We would need a minimal project or some more details, though it is probably the same bug as above

Noticing the names this might be different, and related to input data somewhere, but I can't say what without more details

I added some generic information. 

> Noticing the names this might be different, and related to input data somewhere, but I can't say what without more details

I do have a bunch of input mappings. If it helps i can provide the project.godot file

This isn't helpful I'm sorry, please make sure your code doesn't contain any code accessing things like this, I can't find any code really that would trigger this

If it isn't any code in your project please try to strip it down to make as small a project as possible that triggers this

Do you get these errors in the terminal if you run the project directly from the command line (without opening the editor)?
```
Godot_v4.6-stable_win64.console.exe --path path\to\project
```

> I do have a bunch of input mappings. If it helps i can provide the project.godot file

Yes that would be helpful, the issue seems related to input mappings (`events` and `deadzone`).

> Do you get these errors in the terminal if you run the project directly from the command line (without opening the editor)?

It doesnt happen at all when starting the project, only when loading it in the editor.

These two settings look suspicious to me, where are they from?
```
ui/default_mouse_cursor_shape=""
ui/custom_mouse_cursor="res://assets/textures/cursor_normal.png"
```
I can't find them in the engine, are they added by you? If so they are probably causing this 

If that's the case we probably just need to filter out any invalid entries under `input/` which shouldn't be used by users, it's a hidden prefix
That actually fixed it. They are probably old settings from the time when i started my first project, that i just copied over to get the same look and feel. Thanks a lot

The solution would either be to handle invalid settings in the project settings system, as it shouldn't contain anything except the actions 

Or to add check in the action editor to skip invalid entries

Would have to check how these entries otherwise affect things though to decide 

I have some ideas for fixing this, will see about making a PR for it and test it

Edit: Not considering this critical for 4.7 as it only happens with manually adding invalid settings to the project, cannot happen organically (it's not a regression but an existing issue that was made explicit by changes to `Dictionary`)
